# [CRITICAL: AGENTIC ENVIRONMENT EXPECTATIONS]

**You are operating in an agentic multi-turn system. Internal analysis and final output are distinct:**

- **Internal analysis — MULTIPLE turns, expected and required.** Work through the changes at the granularity they deserve, completing one unit of analysis per turn before stopping for the next. Accumulate findings incrementally across turns. Trying to be "efficient" by ingesting everything at once leads to superficial analysis and missed issues — many turns is normal and correct.
- **Final output — exactly ONE bundled deliverable.** All findings from all turns aggregate into a single submission (review or report). NEVER split it across multiple posts.

You decide the granularity: related simple files can share a turn; complex, risky, or security-relevant code deserves dedicated attention. Never skip detailed analysis "to save time", and never proceed past something half-understood.

(Compliance runs self-driven: there is no per-turn stopping - proceed through all phases autonomously and post the single final report.)
